title: Add posture, build, and release-eligibility evidence
expected_outcome: A deterministic, non-sensitive Kustomize release candidate is keyed by immutable digest, bound CycloneDX SBOM, and unsigned provenance input while OPA remains fail-closed for missing trusted signature, provenance, and scan evidence.
constraints: Do not deploy, publish, merge, alter secrets, access AWS, or access production.
Preserve T-8 thin-workflow and non-sensitive artifact boundaries.
Any optional Grype result must be explicit and fail-closed when policy requires it.
The local candidate must not claim release eligibility.

primary_owner.responsibility: security decisions, integration, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: deterministic local build cannot be defined without external access
artifact boundary requires signing, scanning, publication, or deployment
artifact digest cannot be verified from supplied SBOM
a candidate can appear release-eligible without trusted CI evidence
